topic: Debugging per face metrics and deployment
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging discrepancies in the calculated 'per face' metric, particularly concerning impressions over a 7-day period. Initial checks confirmed that the calculation logic (impressions divided by faces) was correct based on available data fields.

Discrepancies were noted between expected values (e.g., ~178 million) and dashboard figures (66 million). The issue was eventually traced to a bug in ClickHouse aggregation, which required a workaround and subsequent fix deployment.

The session concluded with the decision to promote the corrected data for Brazil from staging to production.
decisions: The calculated 'per face' metric logic is confirmed as correct.
A fix was deployed to address the bug in ClickHouse aggregation.
The updated data for Brazil will be promoted from staging to production.
action_items: Monitor the deployment of the fix (expected within 10 minutes).
Prioritize the release/deployment for Brazil, deferring requests for Ivory Coast and Gabon.
